version.changelog:
Version 1.0.43 of ab-test-analyzer

- No code or documentation changes detected in this update.
- All features, examples, and descriptions remain unchanged.

llm.summary: Instruction-only A/B test analysis skill whose declared requirements and runtime instructions are consistent with its stated purpose; no credentials, installs, or suspicious behavior are requested.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md describes an A/B test analyzer and its example commands and outputs are consistent with that purpose. Minor metadata inconsistencies exist: skill.json contains a generic description and a different version (1.0.0) than the registry metadata (1.0.43), and there is no homepage/source URL. These are likely bookkeeping issues but not indicative of malicious intent.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions stay on-topic: importing test CSVs, running analysis, and generating reports. They do not instruct reading unrelated system files, accessing environment variables, or posting data to external endpoints. The only data referenced is user-provided test_data.csv, which is expected for this functionality.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files are provided (instruction-only). This minimizes on-disk execution risk — nothing will be downloaded or installed by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, credentials, or config paths, which is proportionate for a data-analysis/reporting tool. There are no unexplained secret requests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated persistence. Agent autonomous invocation is permitted (platform default) but not combined with other red flags.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and appears coherent with its stated purpose. Before using: (1) verify where analysis runs (locally in your agent environment vs. an external service) if your workflow requires data privacy; (2) avoid uploading sensitive or production-identifying data — test with anonymized or synthetic CSVs first; (3) note the minor metadata/version mismatch in skill.json — this is likely harmless but you can ask the publisher for source/homepage if you want provenance; (4) if the skill asks at runtime to send data to a URL or to provide credentials, treat that as unexpected and do not proceed without verifying why.
